title: Deliberate Pacing for Human Oversight in Agentic Software Development
abstract: arXiv:2611.09550v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI increasingly enables software development activities to proceed without continuous human involvement. While this autonomy may accelerate development, it also raises questions about when developers can meaningfully oversee software development done by agents. We propose deliberate pacing: intentionally adjusting when and how autonomous development proceeds to preserve opportunities for meaningful oversight. Drawing on an exploratory multivocal literature review of 20 sources, we identify three factors motivating this vision: changing relative costs of human involvement, the timing of oversight opportunities, and interdependencies between pacing decisions across the software development life cycle. We argue that neither uninterrupted autonomy nor frequent human intervention is universal. Instead, pacing should balance opportunities to understand and influence consequential decisions against costs in human attention, development

translated_title: 智能体软件开发中面向人类监督的审慎节奏调控
translated_abstract: 智能体AI日益使软件开发活动能够在没有持续人类参与的情况下自主推进。虽然这种自主性可能加速开发进程，但也引发了一个问题：开发者何时才能对智能体完成的软件开发进行有意义的监督。我们提出了“审慎节奏调控”的概念：通过有意调整自主开发何时以及如何推进，来保留有意义监督的机会。基于对20个文献来源的探索性多视角文献综述，我们识别出支撑这一愿景的三个因素：人类参与相对成本的变化、监督机会出现的时机，以及软件开发生命周期中各节奏调控决策之间的相互依赖关系。我们认为，无论是完全不间断的自主运行还是频繁的人类干预都不是普适方案。相反，节奏调控应当在“理解并影响重大决策的机会”与“人类注意力和开发成本”之间取得平衡……
tldr: 提出了“审慎节奏调控”理念，主张有意调整智能体自主开发的推进时机与方式，在保留人类有效监督的机会与降低人类参与成本之间取得平衡，而非一味追求全自主或频繁干预。
en_tdlr: Proposes "deliberate pacing"—intentionally adjusting when and how agentic autonomous software development proceeds to balance meaningful human oversight opportunities against the costs of human involvement.
